page.meta_description: UseModWiki was the software of the first Wikipedia pages, later migrated into MediaWiki once the English edition outgrew it. Related pages: MediaWiki,…
page.content:
Perl wiki that ran Wikipedia's first months.

How UseModWiki connects

  • Item: MediaWiki — MediaWiki followed UseModWiki as Wikipedia's engine.
  • Topic: Wikipedia — UseModWiki ran Wikipedia before MediaWiki replaced it.

What is UseModWiki?

UseModWiki was the software of the first Wikipedia pages, later migrated into MediaWiki once the English edition outgrew it.

Key threads lead to MediaWiki and Wikipedia.
